Market today: The mood is grim, with headlines pointing to an "AI downturn" sinking stocks and a "brutal market." The real driver is the broad tech/chip sector weakness, directly impacting your highly concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -86.26% with a completely broken stop. MUU (-74.08%) and SMCI (-50.66%) are also in deep trouble. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your stops, especially on the leveraged ETFs. Also, watch for any signs of a market rebound, as historical data suggests steep slides often precede one.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management and cutting losses on your most damaged positions.
plays: Trim CRWD (31.16% gain) to lock in profits and reduce overall portfolio risk.
Cut losses on SOXL (-86.26%). The stop at 200 is irrelevant; exit this leveraged position to prevent further decay.
Consider a small hedge with SQQQ, an inverse QQQ ETF. Scanner shows a LONG setup at entry 54.59-54.33, stop 53.78.
